description: This is a 3D model preview of two sets of gray curtains hanging from white curtain rods. The curtains are designed with pleats, creating a textured and voluminous appearance. The left set consists of two wider curtains, while the right set features two narrower curtains. The fabric appears to have a subtle texture, suggesting it might be a linen blend or a textured polyester. The overall presentation is clean and minimalist, focusing on the form and drape of the curtains.
